why: a += 2 in a file included at k is a = ${?a} [2], fixed up to ${?k.a}; looking back, k.a has no earlier value, so the original path a is looked up as well and k.a appends to it. typesafe/config lets the self-reference end the lookup, the same for the long form, though it falls back for b = ${?a} [2]
